title: The Final Over · CDN Bypass
brief: During the final over of the cricket championship, an operator misconfiguration disables the Edge CDN cache-control headers. Every viewer player now requests video chunks directly from the origin packager.

event.description: Edge CDN cache bypassed; 15,000 req/s bypass the edge cache.

prediction.prompt: With the Edge CDN bypassed (hitRate = 0%), what percentage of video requests will now bombard the Origin Packager?

misconceptions.low: When a CDN cache is bypassed or disabled, zero requests are absorbed at the edge. 100% of player requests hammer your origin servers directly!

palette.label: Restore Edge CDN Caching
palette.description: Re-enable Edge CDN caching with 98% hit rate.

palette.label: Emergency Scale Origin Packager
palette.description: Scale Origin Packager replicas from 4 to 12.
